question: Soham is suffering from goitre. Which deficiency is the most common cause of it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deficiency of Iodine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goitre **is a **swelling of the thyroid gland,** which is located in the neck.
 
• **Iodine deficiency** is the most common cause of goitre.
 
• Iodine is an essential nutrient that is needed for the production of** thyroid hormones.**
 
• Without enough iodine, the thyroid gland can become **enlarged **in an attempt to **produce more hormones.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Protein** is important for **building and repairing tissues,** and for making enzymes and hormones.
 
• A **deficiency of protein** can lead to **muscle wasting, weakened immune function,** and other health problems.
 
• **Vitamin A **is important for **vision, immune function, and skin health.**
 
• A deficiency of vitamin A can lead to** night blindness, dry skin,** and other problems.
 
• **Iron **is needed for making** hemoglobin,** which carries oxygen in the blood.
 
• A deficiency of iron can lead to** anemia, fatigue, and other symptoms.**
